q: Match the department to its zone: Radiology →
n: Lab, pharmacy, radiology = second zone. Remember this: zones go "outside in": OUTER (ER, OPD, admin) → SECOND (lab, pharmacy, radiology) → INNER (nursing) → DEEP (OR, DR, nursery, ICU), with SERVICE (kitchen, laundry, morgue) off to the side. Asepsis = Greek a- "without" + sepsis "rotting".

q: Match the department to its zone: Nursery →
n: Nursery needs asepsis, like the OR and DR.

q: True or false: The mortuary belongs to the service zone.
n: Mortuary sits with dietary, housekeeping and maintenance.

q: Fill in the blank: The dietary service must be at least ___ m from the morgue.
n: 25 m, same number as the parking rule (1 per 25 beds).
